evals.name: cash-forecast
evals.prompt: Build a small local cash forecast tool and its project directory. This is a synthetic example: opening cash is 100, receipts by month are 40, 50, 60, and payments are 70, 60, 50, all in thousands of RMB. Allow a receipts multiplier and recompute closing cash. I am new to coding; explain one calculation and how to run it. Use plain HTML/JS and no external service. I have requested implementation, so proceed when the inputs suffice. Save a brief design, runnable app, and verification notes.
evals.expected_output: Runnable local app, conservative scaffold, correct closing cash, clear explanation and checks
assertions: The app calculates baseline closing balances of 70, 60, 70.
Changing the receipts multiplier recalculates all subsequent balances.
The output identifies synthetic data, RMB thousands, and explains a cash-balance calculation.
The delivered app runs locally without external services and includes run instructions.

evals.name: budget-report
evals.prompt: Create a concise management-report PDF and a static PNG chart from this synthetic data, RMB thousands: revenue budget 200 actual 220; payroll budget 80 actual 95; travel budget 0 actual 5. Show actual-minus-budget amounts and percentages, treating a zero budget as n/a. Include a reproducible plotting script. Edit this supplied sentence without inventing new evidence: 'The robust revenue performance of 220 versus a budget of 200 guarantees that next quarter will be successful.' Flag the unsupported forecast separately. Make the report readable for a manager. Save source files and validation notes.
evals.expected_output: Correct signed variances, no infinite percentage, evidence-preserving prose, compiled PDF, chart, and pure table content with authored section wrapper
assertions: Amount variances are +20 revenue, +15 payroll, +5 travel; percentages are 10%, 18.75%, and n/a.
Expense overruns are not described as favorable merely because positive.
The unsupported guaranteed forecast is flagged separately without invented evidence.
A runnable plotting script, PNG and compiled report PDF are present.
Table content is pure tabular; captions and descriptions are in section wrappers.

evals.name: reconciliation-skill
evals.prompt: I repeat the same bank-to-ledger reconciliation every month and want a reusable local skill. Available installed skills are brainstorming, newproj, plot, frontend-design, latex, humanize, find-skills, and skill-creator. Inspect those capabilities and draft a reconciliation skill if none performs the matching. Inputs have transaction_id, date, amount, currency. Duplicate IDs and unmatched rows must be visible. No web search or installations are needed. Include a concise task-based description, a small worked example, and test prompts including a near miss. Do not add course names or audience labels to the description.
evals.expected_output: Local capability assessment, focused skill with matching rules and exception output, useful examples and evaluation prompts
assertions: The capability assessment identifies the absence of a dedicated matcher without installing or searching externally.
The drafted description specifies matching and exception reporting without audience or course labels.
The workflow exposes duplicate IDs and unmatched rows, preserves currency and source totals.
A worked example and realistic evaluation prompts include a near-miss request.
